content: Hello! how can I help today?
I usually don’t have enough deductions to itemize. Can I bunch expenses?
Yes. Medical expenses are deductible above **7.5% of your AGI** on Schedule A. By concentrating high-cost treatments into one year, you may exceed that floor and itemize effectively.

Eligible costs include:
- Surgery, dental, vision
- Prescription drugs
- Mileage to medical visits (22 cents/mile for 2024)
- Health insurance premiums (if post-tax)
- Home modifications for medical purposes (wheelchair ramps, etc.)
Can I prepay for next year’s procedures?
Yes. You may deduct **prepaid expenses** in the year paid, as long as the services are scheduled and not open-ended. Coordinate payment timing to exceed the AGI threshold.
Should I avoid claiming the standard deduction?
Itemizing only makes sense if total deductions exceed the standard deduction. Bunching medical, charitable, and property taxes into one year can push you above the threshold strategically.
